title: GTA 6's Original Music Score Is Composed by Excellent French Electronic Duo Justice
text: GTA 6's Original Music Score Is Composed by Excellent French Electronic Duo Justice | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 GTA GTA 6's Original Music Score Is Composed by Excellent French Electronic Duo Justice What a cross-over by Robert Ramsey 5 hours ago Share: Image: Push Square If you're a fan of electronic music, you'll probably over the moon to learn that Justice are behind GTA 6's original score. It's an incredibly high profile collaboration; Justice are one of the biggest in the biz, with a catalogue of fantastic albums, singles, and productions stretching back into the mid 2000s. The French duo's involvement was made official earlier today, when Rockstar dropped GTA 6's launch trailer , which features 'Flower In A Hurricane' — a new track composed by Justice (and I think it's an immediate banger). But as alluded, this isn't just a one-and-done. According to the developer's press release, Justice are credited as original score composers, meaning that they've put together most, if not all, of the game's music that isn't existing songs from other artists. Rockstar says that more information on the "original score album" is coming soon. And on top of all this, Rockstar's recreated the pair in a GTA-style artwork. Snazzy: Are you a big Justice fan? Are you hyped to hear they're this heavily involved with GTA 6? Enjoy immaculate vibes in the comments section below.
